Messages.Author: Crucified
Messages.Body:
Just a quick question; if Janvier Montoya (Tremere 9) is used to supply
the blood requirement for resquing a Tremere from torpor, the cost is 1
less <blood>. How about if he is used in conjunction with The Chantry
to rescue a Tremere from torpor? Does the 1 blood cost of The Chantry
become 0 blood or what?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Crucified <baer...@meena.cc.uregina.ca> writes:



No. Chantry says nothing about rescueing a Tremere - It says 'A Tremere
leaves Torpor'. This is not rescue, but simply a change of venue :-)
Since JM reduces his cost to rescue, not to aid in moving to the
Ready Region fomr the Torpor area, his ability does not apply.
